theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (B : ℝ≥0∞), ConvergesWeakly Ts S → (∀ᶠ j in atTop, W ⊆ Us j ∧ (Ts j).massOn W ≤ B) → S.massOn W ≤ B
